actions.neutral: Dominant EMPTY palm openly faces upward near chest; free empty hand relaxed near waist. Keep a small clean space ABOVE dominant palm for separately rendered hovering orb. Do not cup a drawn orb or fake closed weapon grip.
actions.idle: Gentle breathing; dominant upward empty palm stays readable, free hand relaxed; no baked orb/glow.
actions.run: Actual alternating legs, modest sway of dominant upward empty palm near chest; free hand counterbalances. Do not convert run into glide or a still standing pose.
cast-single-target: upright ready with upward empty palm
free hand forms quiet chest seal while dominant palm stays up
brace and lock quiet supportive presentation toward facing ally direction
dominant OPEN palm extends subtly forward/up to release SUPPORT qi, orb itself is not thrown
steady quiet palm presentation, free hand settles; no attack strike
complete fully upright original palm-up neutral recovery
cast-aoe: free hand forms compact inner-world seal; dominant palm stays up
brace as free hand prepares to unfold the veil
free OPEN hand sweeps sideways/outward to open inner-world, dominant palm stays readable
hold calm open presenting posture for sanctuary/control pulses outside body
complete fully upright original palm-up neutral recovery, no kneeling terminal pose
actions.hit: Six keys: flinch, small recoil, knees soften, open-hand steady brace, rise, full original neutral palm-up recovery. Orb is separate hover presentation, never gripped sword.
actions.death: Six keys: stagger, knees buckle, sideways fall, body-ground contact, settle, fully lying terminal corpse. Hand relaxes naturally; root separately decides orb stow/suspension at locked caster origin, never repaints orb into corpse.
actions.meditate: Six true lotus-seated breathing keys; empty hands softly open on lap or in a quiet seal, every key already seated. Orb may hover separately above lap/hand through actual socket; no body-embedded prop/halo.
actions.gather: Six keys: bend, lower one knee, reach empty action hand to ground, lift empty hand, inspect empty palm, complete fully upright palm-up neutral. Separate orb uses stow/hover while action hand gathers, no gathered item or orb painted in hand.
